column3: BSB renders “in this” as “This is why.”
BSB repeats “By faith” for “through which” and “through it.”
BSB puts “He could not be found …” in quotation marks.
BSB renders “sojourned” as “dwelt … as a stranger.”
BSB follows the critical text with “barren” (στεῖρα) and without “gave birth,” which the Textus Receptus adds.
BSB follows the critical text with “welcomed them,” without the Textus Receptus “were persuaded of them.”
BSB adds “on the altar” and “was ready.”
BSB renders “dying” as “when his end was near.”
BSB makes the parents the subject.
BSB renders “the reproach of Christ” as “disgrace for Christ.”
